name: Casey Williams, DMD
description: A general dentistry practice in Boiling Springs providing routine and restorative dental care.

items: Restorative dentistry including fillings and crowns

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Dr. Casey Williams runs a general dentistry practice built around straightforward, prevention-first care.
The practice keeps exams unhurried, so small issues get flagged before they turn into bigger appointments.

items: A first visit includes a full exam and a plain-language rundown of any findings.
Cleanings and checkups are scheduled on a predictable cadence.
Restorative work is scoped and quoted before it is booked.

feature.heading: Unhurried exams, fewer surprises
feature.text: Taking the time on routine exams means fewer surprise appointments for problems that could have been caught earlier.

spotlight.heading: Restorative care, explained plainly
spotlight.text: Fillings, crowns, and other restorative work come with a clear explanation before anything is scheduled.
